⚡ Can #EMS muscle stimulation prevent muscle loss in space? Commissioned by the German Space Agency, a #CharitéBerlin team is probing whether electrical impulses make microgravity training more efficient. #ESA astronaut Sophie Adenot is the study’s first participant, and has now worked out in an EMS suit on the #ISS. 🏃‍♀️ Learn more:

👉 https://www.charite.de/en/service/press_reports/artikel/detail/charite_research_on_the_iss_can_muscle_stimulation_help_astronauts_stay_strong_in_space/
